suppress.notes: CVE-2025-10492 (Java deserialisation, CVSS 9.8) affects the Community JasperReports Library before 7.0.4 and is fixed in 7.0.4 (GHSA-7c3f-cg9x-f3gr; GitLab advisory "affected_range [,7.0.4)"). This build uses the Community library from Maven Central at 7.0.8. It is flagged because the jar's CPE carries no edition, and NVD also lists the commercial Professional edition as affected up to 9.0.2. The regex keeps the suppression to 7.0.4 and later, so a downgrade below the fix brings the finding back. sdk-jasper loads templates from the classpath only (ReportRequest rejects URL, URI, File, Path, streams and readers). Reviewed 2026-10-12.
